description: Read the current screen as addressable elements (@e1, @e2...) for qa_act, with a snapshotQuality verdict; call it before acting and after navigation. Interactive elements only, capped on busy screens (filter finds the rest). A trailing " -" marks a non-clickable element. Refs stay stable while the element stays.

diff.description: Same screen: only added/removed/changed refs since the previous snapshot; a new screen returns the full list.

filter.description: Substring match on text/label/id/role (finds capped elements).

name: qa_snapshot
title: Snapshot the screen
